answer: Behavioral Entropy Scoring. Each identity accrues a history of timing, phrasing, and interaction patterns; newly minted sybils cluster tightly on these features, like a gale of identical gusts. Agents whose correlation with a detected cluster crosses a threshold get throttled or excluded after the fact. An attacker must spend weeks generating genuinely varied behavior per identity, a terrace of divergence that costs real compute and time before any of them becomes usable. Detection lags attacks like a reef catching drift.
